places.name: Angkor Wat (UNESCO World Heritage)
places.ai_summary: Angkor Wat is the largest religious monument in the world, renowned for its stunning Khmer architecture and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early in the morning to catch the sunrise.

places.place_tip: Hire a guide to learn about the temple’s history and significance.

attribution.title: 20171126 Angkor Wat 4712 DxO
attribution.author: Jakub Hałun
attribution.description: View of the central structure of Angkor Wat

places.name: Angkor Thom & Bayon Temple (Faces of Avalokiteshvara)
places.ai_summary: Angkor Thom is a historic city featuring the Bayon Temple, famous for its massive stone faces and intricate carvings.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning to avoid the heat.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes as there is a lot of walking involved.

places.name: Ta Prohm Temple (Tomb Raider Temple)
places.ai_summary: Ta Prohm is a picturesque temple known for its massive tree roots intertwined with ancient ruins, featured in the Tomb Raider movie.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the late afternoon for photography.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the unique scenery.

attribution.description:

places.name: Banteay Srei (Citadel of Women)
places.ai_summary: Banteay Srei is a 10th-century Cambodian temple dedicated to the Hindu god Shiva, known for its intricate carvings and pink sandstone.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for cooler temperatures.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the detailed carvings on the temple walls.

places.name: Preah Khan Temple Complex
places.ai_summary: Preah Khan is a large temple complex at Angkor, built in the 12th century, and dedicated to the Hindu god Vishnu.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the temple complex in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Look out for the unique blend of Hindu and Buddhist elements.

places.name: Phnom Bakheng Hill Sunset View
places.ai_summary: Phnom Bakheng is a temple located on a hilltop, offering panoramic views of the Angkor area, especially beautiful at sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Get there early to secure a good spot for sunset viewing.

places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks, as it can be crowded and hot.

places.name: Angkor National Museum
places.ai_summary: The Angkor National Museum in Siem Reap offers a comprehensive overview of the history, art, and culture of the Khmer Empire.

opening_hours.notes: Allow at least 2 hours for a complete visit.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the galleries on the Khmer Empire’s history.
places.address: Angkor National Museum, Siem Reap, Cambodia

places.name: Tonlé Sap Floating Village (Kampong Phluk)
places.ai_summary: Kampong Phluk is a serene floating village on Tonlé Sap Lake, known for its stilt houses and vibrant community life.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the wet season (May to October) for full experience.

places.place_tip: Respect the local customs and dress modestly.

places.name: Pub Street (Nightlife & Dining)
places.ai_summary: Pub Street is the heart of Siem Reap's nightlife, offering a wide range of bars, restaurants, and shops in a vibrant, pedestrian-friendly area.

opening_hours.notes: Lively atmosphere, especially during the evening and night.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food and enjoy the nightlife.

places.name: Artisans Angkor Craft Workshops
places.ai_summary: Artisans Angkor offers a unique opportunity to explore traditional Cambodian arts and crafts, with workshops and a showroom in Siem Reap.

opening_hours.notes: Workshops may have limited availability, advance booking recommended.

places.place_tip: Participate in a workshop to create your own souvenir.

places.name: Cambodian Cultural Village
places.ai_summary: The Cambodian Cultural Village is a unique theme park in Siem Reap, showcasing the history, culture, and traditions of Cambodia through various exhibits and performances.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for cultural performances.

places.place_tip: Attend a traditional dance performance if available.
places.address: Cambodian Cultural Village, Siem Reap, Cambodia

places.name: Wat Bo Pagoda
places.ai_summary: Wat Bo Pagoda is a historic Buddhist temple in Siem Reap, known for its beautiful murals and peaceful surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: A peaceful place for reflection and photography.

places.place_tip: Respect the local customs and dress modestly.
places.address: Wat Bo Pagoda, Siem Reap, Cambodia

places.ai_summary: Wat Preah Prom Rath is a Buddhist temple in Siem Reap, known for its impressive architecture and serene atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: A tranquil spot for meditation and reflection.

places.place_tip: Explore the temple grounds and enjoy the peaceful environment.

places.name: Banteay Kdei Temple
places.ai_summary: Banteay Kdei is a Buddhist temple in the Angkor complex, known for its intricate carvings and peaceful surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Less crowded than other temples, offering a peaceful visit.

places.place_tip: Take your time to explore the temple and its surroundings.

places.name: Phare Cambodian Circus (Social Enterprise)
places.ai_summary: Phare Cambodian Circus is a unique cultural experience in Siem Reap, combining circus arts with traditional Cambodian storytelling.

opening_hours.notes: Book tickets in advance, as shows often sell out.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to enjoy the pre-show activities.

places.name: War Museum Cambodia
places.ai_summary: War Museum Cambodia in Siem Reap offers a sobering insight into the impact of war on Cambodia, with a focus on the Khmer Rouge era.

opening_hours.notes: Allow at least 1–2 hours for a visit.

places.place_tip: Listen to the audio guides for detailed information.
places.address: War Museum Cambodia, Siem Reap, Cambodia

places.ai_summary: Pre Rup is a temple at Angkor, known for its impressive sunrise views and unique brick sculptures.

opening_hours.notes: Arrive early to find a good spot for sunrise photography.

places.place_tip: Explore the temple complex and enjoy the views.

places.ai_summary: The Khmer Ceramics Fine Arts Center in Siem Reap offers a glimpse into the traditional ceramic arts of Cambodia, with workshops and a showroom.

opening_hours.notes: Workshops may require advance booking.

places.place_tip: Try your hand at pottery in a workshop.

places.name: Old Market (Psar Chaa)
places.ai_summary: Old Market, also known as Psar Chaa, is a popular market in Siem Reap, offering a wide range of local products, souvenirs, and street food.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for fresh produce and local atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Bargain for souvenirs and try the local street food.

places.name: Angkor Night Market
places.ai_summary: Angkor Night Market is a vibrant market in Siem Reap, offering a wide range of handicrafts, souvenirs, and street food in a lively atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Lively atmosphere, especially during the evening and night.

places.place_tip: Explore the various stalls and try the local delicacies.
places.address: Angkor Night Market, Siem Reap, Cambodia
